question: Who authored the popular book Wings of Fire, an autobiography?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Dr. A.P.J. Abdul Kalam**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Dr. A.P.J. Abdul Kalam** authored the popular book "**Wings of Fire**," which is an autobiography of his inspiring life journey.
 
• The book was first published in **1999** and co-authored by **Arun Tiwari**. It narrates Kalam's life story, his contributions to India’s space and missile programs, and his vision for the country.
 
• It provides insights into his early childhood, his struggles, and the challenges he overcame to become one of the most respected scientists and leaders in India. *Hence, the correct answer is Dr. A.P.J. Abdul Kalam.*
 
• **"Wings of Fire"** is not just a personal autobiography but also a motivational book that inspires readers to dream big and work hard to achieve their goals.
 
• Dr. Kalam’s book has been translated into many languages and remains widely popular among students, professionals, and readers interested in India's scientific and political history.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **About Dr. A.P.J. Abdul Kalam:**

 
 
• **Avul Pakir Jainulabdeen Abdul Kalam** (1931–2015) was an eminent Indian scientist, aerospace engineer, and the **11th President of India** (2002–2007).
 
• He played a pivotal role in India’s **missile development program**, earning him the title of "**Missile Man of India**."
 
• Dr. Kalam was associated with prestigious organizations like **DRDO** (Defence Research and Development Organisation) and **ISRO** (Indian Space Research Organisation).
 
• He was awarded several honors, including the **Bharat Ratna** in **1997**, India's highest civilian award, for his contributions to science and technology.
 
 
 
• **Key Themes of "Wings of Fire":**
 
 
• The book emphasizes **hard work, perseverance, and patriotism**, showcasing Dr. Kalam's journey from humble beginnings to becoming one of India’s most influential figures.
 
• It discusses his role in the development of **India’s Satellite Launch Vehicle (SLV)**, the **Agni and Prithvi missiles**, and other scientific advancements.
 
• The book also reflects on his interactions with world leaders, his spiritual beliefs, and his aspirations for India’s youth and development.
 
 
 
• **Other Books by Dr. A.P.J. Abdul Kalam:**
 
 
• Dr. Kalam authored several other inspiring books, including **"Ignited Minds,"** **"India 2020,"** and **"The Luminous Sparks."**
 
• These books focus on his vision for India’s growth and development as a global leader in technology, education, and innovation.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• **Legacy of Dr. A.P.J. Abdul Kalam:**

 
 
• Dr. Kalam’s life and work continue to inspire millions, especially the **youth**, to contribute towards nation-building and achieving their dreams.
 
• He emphasized the importance of **education, innovation, and leadership**, encouraging students to think creatively and work passionately.
 
 
 
• **Significance of "Wings of Fire":**
 
 
• The autobiography remains a classic for understanding the life of one of India’s greatest visionaries and serves as a source of **motivation and guidance** for readers across generations.
